The cartographer framing personas — ensemble diversity is the breadth
mechanism (design P3, §5/S1).
Heuristic.title: Heuristic

RawAngle.description:
One candidate angle exactly as a cartographer emits it, before merger
dedup. Deliberately has NO numeric relevance prior: assigning priors is the
merger's job (design §5/S1); cartographers give a prose rationale only.

distinctness_rationale.description: Why this is a distinct region and not a variant of another angle.
distinctness_rationale.title: Distinctness Rationale

example_options.description: 2-3 concrete options proving the angle is non-empty — existence proofs, never endorsements.
example_options.title: Example Options

relevance_rationale.description: Estimated-relevance rationale in prose, grounded only in the brief and destination model — never a number, never a ranking.
relevance_rationale.title: Relevance Rationale

RawAngle.title: RawAngle

description:
angles/raw/{heuristic} — one cartographer's candidate angles (design §7
lists per-cartographer raw output as a workspace artifact). The merger and
the saturation rule consume these.

angles.description: Target 5-12 candidate angles; fewer than 5 only when the heuristic genuinely yields a narrow harvest (say why in notes).
angles.title: Angles
